blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The proposed pipeline integrates a representation-flow convolutional neural network with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware tree-based Gaussian Process classifier. In this framework, latent motion dynamics are exploited both as discriminative representations and as a source of input uncertainty, enhancing robustness against temporal variations and abnormal motion transitions. Compared with conventional deep learning approaches, the proposed strategy requires less training data and offers improved computational efficiency. To further improve classification performance, we introduce novel semantic-aware compound kernels that effectively capture semantic, flow, and dynamic information embedded in surgical video features. In addition, uncertainty-aware kernels are developed to strengthen the robustness and practical applicability of the compound kernel framework. The proposed method is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, namely the JIGSAWS and the Cataract-LMM (Capsulorhexis) datasets. Experimental results demonstrate strong performance across both datasets, including the LOSO and LOUO evaluation protocols on JIGSAWS, including the subject-independent LOUO protocol on JIGSAWS, on which the framework attains a mean accuracy of ⟨ 96.9 ⟩ \langle 96.9\rangle %; results under the within-subject LOSO protocol are reported for comparability with prior work, achieving competitive accuracy while substantially reducing computational cost. Overall, the proposed pipeline provides an efficient and accurate framework for video-based surgical skill assessment.
blocks.zh: 拟议的输油管将一个代表流革命神经网络与一个动态和不确定性意识树基高斯过程分类器整合. 在这一框架内,潜在运动动态既被利用为歧视性表述,又被利用为输入不确定性的来源,从而增强了抵御时间变化和异常运动过渡的稳健性。 与传统的深入学习方法相比,拟议战略要求的培训数据较少,而且提高了计算效率。 为了进一步提高分类性能,我们引入了新颖的语义感知复合内核,有效捕捉植入外科视频功能的语义,流,动态信息. 此外,还开发了认识到不确定性的内核,以加强复合内核框架的稳健性和实用性. 拟议方法在两个基准数据集,即JIGSAWS和Cataract-LMM(Capsulorhexis)数据集上进行评估。 实验结果表明,两个数据集的性能均很强,其中包括关于JIGSAWS的LOSO和LOUO评价协议,包括关于JIGSAWS的LOOO主题议定书,该框架的平均精度为96.9 \langle 96.9\rangle%;报告在LOSO协议下的结果与先前的工作具有可比性,实现了竞争性准确性,同时大幅度降低了计算成本。 总体而言,拟议的管道为基于视频的外科手术技能评估提供了一个有效和准确的框架。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Surgical skill assessment is the process of evaluating a surgeon’s technical ability and competence in performing surgical procedures to ensure patient safety and the quality of care delivered. Skill assessments play a crucial role in certifying aspiring surgeons. [ 1 ] Such assessments aid in efficient skill acquisition by providing specific guidance on areas that need improvement [ 2 , 3 , 1 , 4 , 5 ] . The notion of automating the process of surgical skill evaluation has emerged as a promising solution [ 6 , 5 ] . This approach could save time and resources, while also enabling novice surgeons to train with increased autonomy( using a surgical simulator that provides automatic assessment and feedback), moving towards independence in surgical skill assessment. However, it is important to note that this progress is still in line with the current trend in surgical automation, which emphasizes augmented assistance rather than complete replacement of expert supervision. As a result, there has been a growing interest in the research community on automatic skill evaluation over the past decade.
blocks.zh: 外科手术技能评估是评估外科医生进行外科手术的技术能力和能力的过程,以确保病人的安全以及所提供的护理的质量。 技能评估在认证有抱负的外科医生方面发挥着关键作用。 [ 1] 通过就需要改进的领域提供具体指导,这类评估有助于有效获得技能[2、3、1、4、5]。 使手术技能评估过程自动化的概念已经成为一种很有希望的解决办法[6,5]。 这种方法可以节省时间和资源,同时使新手外科医生能够接受更多自主性的培训(使用提供自动评估和反馈的外科模拟器),在外科技能评估方面走向独立。 然而,必须指出,这一进展仍然符合目前手术自动化的趋势,即强调增加援助,而不是完全取代专家监督。 因此,过去十年来,研究界对自动技能评价的兴趣越来越大。

blocks.en: In automated surgical skill assessment (ASSA), sensory data such as robot kinematics, tool motion, force, or video data are collected during surgical training. This data is subsequently analyzed to determine the trainee’s surgical skill level, which can be expressed either numerically as the average score or categorically as novice, intermediate, or expert [ 6 ] . The commonly used methods in ASSA are neural networks (NNs), Hidden Markov Models (HMMs), and Support Vector Machines (SVMs) [ 5 ] . Recent research has shown that while SVMs and HMMs can still be effective for certain video classification tasks, their performance often lags behind more advanced deep learning methods, such as 3D CNNs or transformers, especially for large-scale and complex datasets [ 6 ] . HMMs [ 7 , 8 ] can capture the temporal dependencies of the actions and can be trained using annotated surgical videos or physiological signals. In addition, it can capture the underlying patterns of the data and make probabilistic predictions. HMMs can’t learn a huge dataset and function as well as NNs. Nevertheless, these approaches can learn and perform acceptably using less data in some applications, such as ASSA [ 5 ] However, tuning the hyper-parameters of the HMMs are not straightforward [ 9 , 10 ] . SVMs can handle non-linear decision boundaries through the use of kernel functions. However, SVMs are sensitive to the choice of kernel function and parameters. The computational complexity of SVM procedures is light, while it is an arduous process for multi-label and massive datasets [ 11 ] . According to the state-of-the-art research [ 5 ] , the achievable performance accuracy of the SVMs for video classification is yet not satisfactory. In addition, CNNs can learn to estimate the locations of surgeons’ tools from surgical videos, such as Temporal Segment Networks (TSN) and Faster Region-based CNN (Faster-RCNN) [ 12 , 13 ] . CNNs have also been trained to provide interpretable, domain-specific feedback to trainees, such as highlighting suboptimal tool trajectories, pinpointing spatial movement errors via activation maps, or assigning objective skill scores [ 14 ] . Although the deep learning-based approaches can accurately perform assessments [ 15 , 16 ] , however, to learn well, they require very rich datasets with highly intricate computations.
blocks.zh: 在自动化外科技能评估(ASSA)中,在外科训练中收集机器人动能,工具运动,力,或视频数据等感官数据. 随后对这一数据进行了分析,以确定受训人员的外科技术水平,这种水平可以用数字表示为平均得分,也可以明确表示为新手、中级或专家[6]。 SASA中常用的方法有神经网络(NNs),隐藏的Markov模型(HMM),以及支持矢量机(SVM). [5]. 最近的研究表明,虽然SVMs和HMM仍然能够有效地完成某些视频分类任务,但其性能往往落后于更先进的深层学习方法,例如3D CNN或变压器,特别是大型和复杂的数据集[6]. HMM [7,8] 能够捕捉动作的时间依赖性,并且可以通过附加注释的外科视频或生理信号进行训练. 此外,它可以捕捉数据的基本规律,并作出概率预测. HMM不能学习巨大的数据集和功能以及NN. 然而,这些方法可以在某些应用中使用较少的数据来学习和采用,例如SSA[5],但是,高计量元的超参数的调试并不简单[9、10]。 SVM可以通过使用内核函数来处理非线性决定边界. 然而,SVMs对内核函数和参数的选择很敏感. SVM程序在计算上的复杂性是轻而易举的,而对于多标签和大规模数据集来说,这是一个艰巨的过程[11]. 根据最新研究[5],用于视频分类的SVM的可实现性能精度尚不令人满意. 此外,有线电视新闻网还可以通过外科录像,如Temperal片段网络(TSN)和基于更快区域的有线电视新闻网(Faster-RCNN)[12,13],来估计外科医生的工具位置. CNN还接受了培训,向受训人员提供可解释的、针对特定领域的反馈,例如强调非最佳工具轨迹,通过激活地图确定空间移动错误,或分配客观技能分数[14]。 虽然深层的以学习为基础的方法能够准确地进行评估[15、16],但为了学习好,它们需要非常丰富的数据集,并进行高度复杂的计算。

blocks.en: While most ASSA methods primarily analyze robot kinematic or tool motion data, acquiring such data necessitates access to either a robotic surgical system or specialized tracking systems, which makes it complex and costly in practice [ 17 ] . In contrast, video data can be effortlessly obtained in both traditional and robot-assisted minimally invasive surgery, primarily because modern operating rooms are now routinely equipped with high-definition endoscopic and external cameras that facilitate seamless data collection [ 18 , 19 ] . However, video data is high-dimensional and much more intricate than sequences of a few motion variables. The recorded video can be used to obtain kinematic data by tracking surgical tools and assess surgical skill by analyzing this data without the requirement of having motion tracking markers [ 20 ] . Such kinematic data can also be obtained using convolutional neural networks (CNNs). In [ 21 ] , the authors propose a deep neural network for articulated multi-instrument 2-D pose estimation, which is trained on detailed annotations of endoscopic and microscopic data sets. The overall scheme can effectively localize instrument joints and also estimate the articulation model. In another approach, video data can be converted to time series for ASSA. In [ 22 ] , the authors use entropy-based features approximate entropy, and cross-approximate entropy to find the difference in the predictability of motions. This method is based on the fact that an expert surgeon will have more predictable hand motion while a beginner will exhibit erratic and irregular patterns.
blocks.zh: 虽然大多数SASA方法主要分析机器人动能数据或工具运动数据,但获取此类数据需要使用机器人外科系统或专门的跟踪系统,这使其在实践中变得复杂和昂贵[17]. 与此相反,视频数据可以在传统和机器人协助的最小侵入性手术中不费力地获得,这主要是因为现代手术室现在经常配备高清晰度的内视和外部摄像机,以便于无缝数据收集[18、19]。 然而,视频数据是高维度的,比几个运动变量的序列要复杂得多. 记录下来的视频可以用来通过跟踪手术工具来获取运动数据,并通过分析这些数据来评估手术技能,而不需要有运动跟踪标记[20]. 这种动能数据也可以通过演化神经网络(CNN)获得. 在[21]中,作者提议建立一个深层神经网络,用于清晰的多仪器2-D平面估计,该网络受过关于内视和微镜数据集详细说明的培训。 总体计划可以有效地使仪器关节本地化,并估计表达模式。 在另一种方法中,视频数据可以转换成时间序列用于ASSA. 在[22]中,作者使用Entropy基特征近似Entropy,和跨近似Entropy来发现运动的可预测性的差异. 这种方法的基础是:专家外科医生的手动能力会更可预测,而初学者则会表现出不稳定和不规则的规律.

blocks.en: The two above methods discussed require intermediate steps, which brings in complexity. Furthermore, in [ 16 ] , both spatial and temporal information are captured using CNNs for surgical skill assessment. Thus, new studies have been focused on methods that exclusively rely on using surgical videos. In video-based action recognition and skill assessment, some strategies [ 23 , 24 ] demonstrate that utilization of optical flows of videos with RGB videos simultaneously causes further accuracy in classification. For this purpose, [ 16 ] has rendered a two-streamed CNN, which contains two parallel networks and gets two kinds of inputs: RGB frame sequences and optical flow feature maps, while satisfactory accuracy is acquired, the computations are very intricate. Performed experiments of such networks in surgical skill assessment demonstrate that accuracy has increased compared to that of the trained model with only RGB frames [ 25 ] . Computing optical flows of videos compel us to consume additional time. To overcome this issue, [ 26 ] introduces a unified structure that uses optical flow features, although employing this structure in action recognition has been performed with better precision than two-streamed CNNs. Since this network is very promising, it has been applied in our surgical skill assessment framework. In another study [ 27 ] , a real-time Gaussian process-based approach has been used for real-time ASSA using kinematic data.
blocks.zh: 讨论的上述两种方法需要中间步骤,这带来了复杂性。 此外,在[16]中,空间和时间信息都利用CNN进行外科技术评估。 因此,新的研究侧重于完全依靠手术录像的方法。 在基于视频的动作识别和技能评估中,一些战略[23,24]表明,使用带有RGB视频的视频光学流同时导致分类更加准确. 为此,[16] 制作了一个双流的CNN,它包含两个平行的网络并获得两种投入: RGB帧序列和光学流特征图,虽然获得了令人满意的精度,但计算非常复杂. 在外科技术评估中对这些网络进行的实验表明,与只有RGB帧的经过培训的模型相比,精度有所提高[25] 。 视频的光学流动迫使我们消耗更多的时间。 为克服这一问题,[26]引入了使用光学流体特征的统一结构,虽然在动作识别中采用这一结构的精度比双流CNN更精确. 由于这个网络很有希望,它已被应用到我们的外科技能评估框架中。 在另一项研究[27]中,使用动能数据实时使用高斯工艺法进行ASSA.

blocks.en: Beyond this optical-flow lineage, video-based SSA has been pursued from several complementary directions by different groups. One line of work performs frame-level feature extraction with temporal aggregation, e.g., Temporal Segment Networks and related architectures that pool clip-level evidence over time [ 12 ] . A second direction couples convolutional encoders with recurrent or temporal-convolutional models to capture the sequential structure of a procedure and, in some cases, to localise the gestures that drive a skill rating. A third, increasingly influential direction targets interpretability and actionable feedback rather than a single score, e.g., multi-task models that jointly predict skill and generate trainee-facing feedback [ 14 ] . A fourth body of work emphasises objective, contactless performance metrics and hand/instrument motion recovered directly from video [ 28 , 29 ] , while recent surveys document the rapid diversification of these methods [ 5 , 6 , 30 ] . Importantly, these efforts span surgical domains well beyond robotic bench-top tasks: video-based skill assessment has been studied extensively in laparoscopic and, more recently, in ophthalmic surgery; for instance, the capsulorhexis phase of cataract surgery, for which large multi-centre resources such as the Cataract-LMM benchmark now provide objective surgical skill scores across procedures using a multi-indicator rubric adapted from validated clinical standards [ 31 ] . A recurring theme across these studies is that generalisation across procedures, centres, and acquisition conditions remains an open challenge [ 4 ] . Our work is positioned within this landscape: rather than competing on raw model capacity, we focus on the limited-data, computationally constrained regime, and we adopt the representation-flow backbone introduced above for its motion-awareness without the cost of explicit optical-flow precomputation.
blocks.zh: 除了这种光学流线外,不同群体还从几个互补方向追求基于视频的SSA. 一行工作用时间汇总来进行帧级特征提取,例如,时间段网络和相关架构,将剪切级证据汇集到一段时间[12]. 第二种方向是:夫妇用反复出现或时间演变的模型编解码器来捕捉一个程序的顺序结构,并在某些情况下将驱动技能评级的手势定位. 第三个越来越有影响力的方向目标是可解释性和可操作性反馈,而不是单一的分数,例如联合预测技能并产生见习反馈的多任务模式[14]. 第四套工作强调客观、无接触性能衡量标准以及直接从视频[28、29]中恢复的手/仪器运动,而最近的调查记录了这些方法的迅速多样化[5、6、30]。 重要的是,这些努力涉及手术领域,远远超出了机器人板凳上的任务范围:对视像技术评估进行了广泛的研究,最近对眼科手术进行了广泛的研究;例如白内障手术的顶部肌瘤阶段,Cataract-LMM基准等大型多中心资源现在利用根据经验证的临床标准改编的多指标分数提供客观的手术技能分数。 在这些研究中反复出现的一个主题是,跨程序、中心和获取条件的通用仍然是一项公开的挑战。 我们的工作就在这个格局中进行:我们不是在原始模型能力上进行竞争,而是侧重于有限数据、在计算上受限制的制度,我们采用上面引入的表示-流主干线来提高运动意识,而不需要明确的光学流预计算。

blocks.en: Recent progress in video understanding has also been driven by transformer-based architectures (video vision transformers) that model long-range temporal dependencies via self-attention. These models often achieve strong performance when pretrained on large-scale video datasets and then fine-tuned to downstream tasks. However, their effective training typically requires substantial compute and careful regularization, which can be challenging in small-data surgical benchmarks.
blocks.zh: 最近在视频理解方面的进展也由基于变压器的架构(视频视距变压器)驱动,这些架构通过自觉来模拟远程时间依赖性. 这些模型在大规模视频数据集上预训,然后细化到下游任务时往往能实现强性能. 然而,他们的有效培训通常需要大量计算和谨慎的正规化,这在小数据外科基准方面可能具有挑战性。

blocks.en: To address the aforementioned limitations, we propose RF-DUAGP-Tree, a novel framework for surgical skill assessment that combines Representation Flow [ 26 ] -based spatio-temporal feature extraction(RF) with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware Gaussian Process Tree classifier(DUAGP-Tree) which is the enhanced version of GP-Tree [ 32 ] . The proposed framework introduces clip-level latent motion dynamics descriptors, including motion trend, acceleration, and jerk, which are jointly utilized as discriminative features and uncertainty indicators. Furthermore, semantic compositional uncertainty kernels are developed to explicitly model the heterogeneous semantics of surgical motion representations and improve robustness to temporal fluctuations and abnormal transitions. The proposed method is evaluated on the JIGSAWS [ 33 ] and the Cataract-LMM (hereafter referred to as the Capsulorhexis dataset) benchmarks [ 31 ] , demonstrating competitive performance while requiring fewer training samples and lower computational cost than existing deep learning-based approache.
blocks.zh: 为了解决上述限制,我们提议采用RF-DUAGP-Tree,这是手术技能评估的新框架,将表现流[26]-基于语序的时态特征提取(RF)与动态和不确定性的高斯过程树分类器(DUAGP-Tree)结合起来,后者是GP-Tree的增强版[32]. 拟议框架引入了短片级潜在运动动态描述符,包括运动趋势、加速和混蛋,它们共同用作歧视性特征和不确定性指标。 此外,还开发了语义构成不确定性内核,以明确模拟外科运动表现的异质语义,并改进对时间波动和异常过渡的稳健性。 拟议的方法根据JIGSAWS[33]和Cataract-LMM(以下简称Capsulorhexis数据集)基准[31]加以评价,表明具有竞争力的业绩,同时要求培训样本和计算成本低于现有的深层学习方法。

blocks.en: The remainder of the paper is structured as follows. In Section 2 , an overview of the background and preliminaries are presented. Next, in Section 3 , we discuss the proposed pipeline for SSA. Section 4 , provides the results of the proposed method compared to the existing ones. Finally, the concluding remarks are given in Section 6 .
blocks.zh: 本文件其余部分的结构如下。 第2节概述了背景和初步情况。 接下来,我们在第3节中讨论为特别服务协定提议的管道。 第4节提供了拟议方法与现有方法相比的结果。 最后,结论意见载于第6节。

blocks.en: 2 Background and Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 2 背景和序言

blocks.en: 2.1 JIGSAWS
blocks.zh: 2.1 江苏

blocks.en: The JHU-ISI Gesture and Skill Assessment Working Set (JIGSAWS) [ 33 ] is a publicly available surgical dataset created by researchers at Johns Hopkins University and the University of Southern California. The dataset contains recordings of surgical tasks performed by both experienced and novice surgeons using the da Vinci Surgical System. The JIGSAWS dataset includes videos of three surgical tasks: needle passing, suturing, and knot tying. The dataset also includes kinematic and tool usage data, such as the position and orientation of the surgical instruments, the amount of force applied by the surgeon, and the speed of the movements. JIGSAWS also contains annotations for surgical gestures and skill, which have been rendered manually, based on an experimental setup that comprises two standard cross-validations and a C++/Matlab toolkit to analyze surgical gestures employing hidden Markov models and utilizing linear dynamical systems. A summary of skill levels for different procedures of JIGSAWS is summarized in Table 1 . As observed from the table the videos do not have the same number of frames and the number of videos for each task is limited.
blocks.zh: JHU-ISI手势与技能评估工作集(JIGSAWS)[33]是约翰·霍普金斯大学和南加州大学的研究人员创建的可公开获取的外科数据集. 数据集包含经验丰富的外科医生和新科医生使用达芬奇外科系统完成的外科手术任务的录音. JIGSAWS数据集包括三个外科手术任务的视频:穿针、缝合和结结结。 数据集还包括动能和工具使用数据,如外科仪器的位置和方向,外科医生施用的力量量,运动速度等. JIGSAWS还包含外科手势和技能的说明,这些手势和技能是人工制作的,其基础是一个实验设置,包含两个标准交叉验证和一个C++/Matlab工具包,用于分析外科手势,使用隐藏的Markov模型并利用线性动态系统. 表1汇总了JIGSAWS不同程序的技能水平。 如表所示,录像带的帧数并不相同,每项任务的录像数量有限。

blocks.en: 2.2 Capsulorhexis Dataset (Cataract-LMM)
blocks.zh: 2.2 Capsulorhexis 数据集(Cataract-LMM)

blocks.en: The Capsulorhexis dataset utilized in this study is derived from the Skill Assessment subset of the Cataract-LMM benchmark [ 31 ] . This specific subset comprises video clips focused exclusively on the capsulorhexis phase of phacoemulsification surgery. To support objective competency assessment, each clip is annotated with quantitative skill scores based on a video-based rubric developed by a consensus panel of consultant ophthalmic surgeons and medical education experts. The evaluation framework adapts six core performance indicators from the validated GRASIS and ICO-OSCAR standards: Instrument Handling, Tissue Handling, Microscope Use, Commencement of Flap, Circular Completion, and Motion. Each indicator is assessed on a 5-point scale, culminating in a continuous overall proficiency score for each procedure.

blocks.en:
Representation Flow (RF) [26] is the front end of the proposed framework and is used here exclusively as a motion-aware feature extractor. Because its parameters are fine-tuned in this work and its outputs define the descriptors f f , v v , a a and j j , we summarise it here in a self-contained form. Motivation. Conventional two-stream action-recognition pipelines pre-compute a dense optical-flow field on the RGB frames using an iterative TV-L1 solver, store it, and process it with a second network. This is accurate but expensive: the flow computation is an offline pass over every frame pair and is not adapted to the recognition task. Representation Flow instead implements the TV-L1 iteration as a differentiable layer inside a single 3D convolutional network, and applies it not to pixels but to the network’s own intermediate feature maps. Motion is therefore represented as the apparent displacement field of learned feature channels between adjacent temporal positions, it is computed within the forward pass, and the parameters of the flow computation are themselves trainable. Architecture. The backbone is a pretrained 3D CNN consisting of a stem ( conv3D → ightarrow BatchNorm3D → ightarrow maxpool3D ), two stages of 3D residual blocks, the flow layer, two further stages of 3D residual blocks, and a final pre-classification 3D convolution (Fig. 2). blocks.en: Gaussian process (GP) is a non-parametric Bayesian approach for active learning and optimizing unknown functions for both regression and classification. Contrary to NN methods, GP is less dependent on the massive training data sets for generalization. This will help the development of an ASSA pipeline with limited training data. Since GP contains few training parameters, it is also computationally efficient. Thus, it does not add computational complexity when being used along with NNs. In what follows, we will discuss the preliminaries for GP classification.

blocks.en: 3 Proposed Method
blocks.zh: 3 拟议方法

blocks.en: In this section, we elaborate on the proposed pipeline for ASSA using video data. The proposed method is a 3D CNN with an inherent representation flow algorithm 2.3 , originally introduced in [ 26 ] , coupled with DUAGP-Tree (dynamics-and-Uncertainty-aware robust GP-Tree), referred to as RF- DUAGP-Tree-Tree. As discussed earlier, DUAGP-Tree is based on the GP-Tree method. DUAGP-Tree is robust to abrupt temporal fluctuations and abnormal transitions, while utilizing latent motion dynamics, especially as discriminative features introduced in this study. In other words, latent motion dynamics play two crucial and contrasting roles in the method: 1. dynamic features, and 2. uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们详细阐述了利用视频数据为特别敏感区提议的管道。 建议的方法是一种3D CNN,内在的表示流算法2.3 ,最初在[26]中引入,与DUAGP-Tree(动力学-和-不确定性-意识强的GP-Tree)结合,称为RF-DUAGP-Tree-Tree. 如前所述,DUAGP-Tree基于GP-Tree方法. DUAGP-Tree对突然的时间波动和异常过渡很强,同时利用潜在的运动动态,特别是作为本研究中引入的歧视性特征。 换句话说,潜在的运动动态在方法中起到两个关键和相对的作用: 1. 动态特征和2. 不确定性。

blocks.en: Compared with the state-of-the-art method [ 16 ] , the proposed framework demonstrates superior data efficiency by achieving competitive performance with a substantially reduced training set on the Capsulorhexis task 4.9 . For example, on the Capsulorhexis dataset, only 30 training videos are required, whereas the reference approach utilizes approximately 140 videos for training. A schematic of the proposed pipeline is depicted in Figure 2 .

blocks.en: In contrast to the GP-Tree framework introduced in [ 32 ] , the proposed DUAGP-Tree eliminates the Deep Kernel Learning (DKL) stage. Instead, classification is performed using engineered representations derived from the feature maps generated by the Representation Flow (RF) network. As these representations already encode rich spatiotemporal motion information, an additional deep kernel transformation becomes unnecessary. This design not only simplifies the overall architecture but also reduces computational complexity while preserving discriminative capability.
blocks.zh: 与[32]引入的GP-Tree框架形成对比的是,拟议的DUAGP-Tree取消了深内尔学习(DKL)阶段. 相反,采用从代表流程(RF)网络生成的特征图中生成的工程说明进行分类。 由于这些表示法已经编码了丰富的spatiotemporal运动信息,额外的深内核转换变得没有必要. 这种设计不仅简化了整体架构,还降低了计算的复杂性,同时保留了歧视能力.

blocks.en: The DUAGP-Tree classifier serves as the primary decision-making component of the proposed framework. The Representation Flow (RF) network is utilized exclusively for feature extraction and is initialized with pretrained weights. To account for task-specific characteristics, only a lightweight fine-tuning stage is performed on the RF network before extracting feature representations. These representations are then provided to the DUAGP-Tree classifier, thereby decoupling feature extraction from probabilistic classification and reducing the overall training burden.
blocks.zh: DUAGP-Tree分类法是拟议框架的主要决策部分。 代表流动网络专门用于地物提取,初始化时使用预先训练过的权重。 为考虑具体任务的特点,在提取特征表达之前,在RF网络上只进行轻量级微调阶段. 这些表述随后提供给DUAGP-Tree分类器,从而将特征提取与概率分类脱钩,并减轻整体培训负担.

blocks.en: The proposed DUAGP-Tree retains the key advantages of Gaussian Process (GP)-based models, including effective learning from limited training data and reduced computational requirements. As described previously, the classifier operates on representations derived from the feature maps generated by the Representation Flow (RF) network. These feature maps are extracted at the clip level, where each surgical video is partitioned into a sequence of consecutive clips. Clips are an internal device for handling videos of unequal length and are never treated as independent samples: the feature maps of all clips of a video are aggregated into a single video-level representation with a single label before classification, so that the video is the atomic unit of every train/test partition. To obtain a video-level representation, the feature maps corresponding to successive clips are aggregated and concatenated, resulting in a unified representation for each video.
blocks.zh: 拟议的DUAGP-Tree保留了基于高斯进程(GP)模型的关键优势,包括有效学习有限的培训数据和减少计算要求. 如前所述,分类器以代表流(RF)网络生成的特征图衍生的表示方式运作. 这些特征图是在剪辑级别上提取的,每个外科视频被分割成连续剪辑的序列. Clips是处理长度不均的视频的内部设备,从不作为独立样本处理: 视频所有片段的特征图被汇总为单一的视频级别代表,分类前有单一的标签,因此视频是每个列车/测试分区的原子单位. 为了获得视频层面的表示,与相继剪辑对应的特写地图进行汇总和整理,使每段视频都有统一的表示.

blocks.en: The dimensionality of the extracted feature maps is excessively high for efficient function inference within the DUAGP-Tree framework. Furthermore, the derivative-based representations ( v v , a a , and j j ) may introduce additional noise due to the amplification of temporal fluctuations. To address these challenges, the feature maps are transformed into compact summary representations that preserve the most informative characteristics while substantially reducing dimensionality.
blocks.zh: 提取出的地物图的维度过高,在DUAGP-Tree框架内的高效函数推论. 此外,基于衍生物的表示(v v, a, 和 j )可能会由于时间波动的扩大而产生额外的噪声. 为应对这些挑战,专题地图被转化为紧凑的简要说明,保留了信息最丰富的特征,同时大大减少了维度。

blocks.en: Specifically, each video-level feature representation f f is summarized using its mean, standard deviation, and the number of clips. Similarly, the derivative-based representations v v , a a , and j j are characterized using a set of descriptive statistics, including the mean, standard deviation, energy, and entropy. These summary features provide a compact representation of the underlying motion dynamics while maintaining the discriminative information required for skill assessment.
blocks.zh: 具体地说,每个视频级别的特写ff被用其平均值,标准偏差和剪辑数量来总结. 同样,基于衍生物的表示 v , a , 和 j 的特征也使用一组描述性统计,包括平均值,标准偏差,能量,和 en. 这些概要特征在保持技能评估所需的歧视性信息的同时,对基本运动动态作了紧凑的表述。

blocks.en: It should be noted that two distinct feature streams are extracted from the Representation Flow network. The first stream consists of features obtained from the representation flow layer, whereas the second stream is derived from the final layer of the network’s last block. These feature streams capture complementary aspects of surgical motion and are investigated separately through the ablation studies. Experimental results indicate that the most effective configuration is obtained by jointly utilizing both feature streams.
blocks.zh: 应当指出,从代表流动网络中提取了两种不同的特征流。 第一流由代表流层获得的特征组成,而第二流则由网络最后一个块的最后一层产生. 这些特征流捕捉到外科手术运动的互补方面,并通过衰竭研究单独调查. 实验结果表明,最有效的配置是通过联合利用两个特征流来实现的。

blocks.en: This design is particularly advantageous for Gaussian Process learning, as compact yet informative representations improve computational efficiency while mitigating the risk of overfitting in limited-data settings.
blocks.zh: 这种设计对高斯进程学习特别有利,因为紧凑但内容翔实的表述可以提高计算效率,同时降低在有限数据环境中过度适应的风险。

blocks.en: In contrast to the Capsulorhexis dataset, the feature maps extracted from JIGSAWS contain rich discriminative information that should be preserved rather than aggressively summarized. Consequently, the primary feature representations f f are utilized directly within the proposed framework. Specifically, these representations are incorporated through separate embedding and temporal components using the compositional kernels introduced in Section 3.2 .
blocks.zh: 与Capsulorhexis数据集不同,从JIGSAWS中提取的地物图含有丰富的歧视性信息,应当加以保存,而不是粗略归纳。 因此,在拟议框架内直接使用ff的主要说明。 具体地说,这些表述是通过使用第3.2节中引入的构成内核的单独嵌入部分和时间部分纳入的。

blocks.en: The derivative-based representations ( v v , a a , and j j ) inherently encode temporal dynamics through their latent feature trajectories. Therefore, preserving their full temporal dimension is unnecessary. Instead, temporal mean pooling is applied to each representation, yielding compact descriptors that retain the essential dynamic characteristics while reducing dimensionality and computational complexity.
blocks.zh: 基于衍生物的表示(v v, a, and j j )通过其潜伏的特征轨迹内在地编码时间动态. 因此,没有必要保留其全部时间范围。 相反,时间平均集合适用于每个代表,产生紧凑的描述符,保留基本的动态特征,同时降低维度和计算的复杂性。

blocks.en: Similar to the Capsulorhexis setting, two complementary feature streams are considered: (i) features extracted from the representation flow layer and (ii) features obtained from the pre-classification layer of the network. These streams are incorporated through separate semantic compositional kernels, as described in Section 3.2 . The proposed kernels are designed to jointly exploit the complementary information contained in the latent feature representation f f and its derivative-based dynamic descriptors ( v v , a a , j j ).
blocks.zh: 与Capsulorhexis设定类似,考虑两个互补的特征流:(一)从代表流层提取的特征和(二)从网络的前分类层获得的特征. 如第3.2节所述,这些流体通过单独的语义组成内核进行整合。 拟议的内核旨在联合利用潜在特征f表示法及其衍生基动态描述符(v v , a, j j )中所载的补充信息.

blocks.en: Overall, the proposed semantic-aware compound kernels are specifically designed to capture the complementary semantic and dynamic information encoded in the latent feature representation and its temporal derivatives. These kernels form a key component of the DUAGP-Tree framework, enabling effective modeling of surgical motion patterns across different skill levels. In addition, the proposed uncertainty-aware kernels, presented in Section 3.2 , extend this formulation by explicitly incorporating uncertainty information derived from latent motion dynamics, thereby enhancing robustness to temporal variability and abnormal transitions.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,拟议的语义-意识复合内核是专门用来捕捉在潜在特征表示及其时间衍生物中编码的互补语义和动态信息. 这些内核构成了DUAGP-Tree框架的关键组成部分,使得不同技能水平的手术运动模式能够有效建模. 此外,第3.2节中提议的具有不确定性的内核,通过明确纳入潜在运动动态产生的不确定性信息,从而增强时间变异性和异常过渡的稳健性,扩大了这一表述。

blocks.en: To incorporate the second role of latent motion dynamics, namely uncertainty modeling, the covariance formulation of the proposed DUAGP-Tree is inspired by previously developed robust Gaussian Process methodologies. The underlying motivation is that temporal fluctuations, motion irregularities, and abrupt transitions observed in surgical videos can be interpreted as a source of input uncertainty and should therefore be explicitly accounted for during probabilistic inference.
blocks.zh: 为了纳入潜在运动动态的第二个作用,即不确定性模型的制定,拟议的DUAGP-Tree的共变形式受到以前开发的强势高斯进程方法的启发。 其根本动机是,手术录影带中观察到的时间波动,运动异常和突变,可以解释为输入不确定性的来源,因此在概率推论时应当明确说明.

blocks.en: Previous studies [ 42 , 43 ] introduced robust Gaussian Process formulations capable of handling uncertainty and noise in the input space. In [ 42 ] , Gaussian Process models are learned directly from noisy inputs, whereas [ 43 ] assumes that the inputs are first denoised before model construction. Inspired by these formulations, we extend the concept from input-noise modeling to uncertainty induced by latent motion dynamics.
blocks.zh: 以前的研究[42,43]引入了能够处理输入空间中的不确定性和噪音的强力高斯工艺配方. 在[42]中,高斯工艺模型直接从吵闹的输入中学习,而[43]则假设这些输入在模型构建之前首先被去名化. 受这些提法的启发,我们把这一概念从输入噪音模型扩大到潜在运动动态引起的不确定性。

blocks.en: The proposed kernels are designed to jointly exploit the complementary information contained in the latent feature representation f and its derivative-based dynamic descriptors v v , a a , j j . Since these components encode distinct semantic and dynamic characteristics of surgical motion, modeling them through a single homogeneous kernel may fail to fully capture their individual contributions. blocks.zh: 不确定- 意识核心

blocks.en: In conventional ARD-RBF kernels, the length-scale parameter governs the sensitivity of the similarity function and determines the effective influence region of each sample. However, in standard formulations, this parameter is typically independent of the data uncertainty and is either fixed or learned without explicit consideration of input variability.
blocks.zh: 在常规的ARD-RBF内核中,长度尺度参数管辖相似性函数的敏感性,并确定每个样本的有效影响区域. 然而,在标准表述中,这一参数通常独立于数据不确定性,是固定的,或者是在没有明确考虑输入变量的情况下学习的.

blocks.en: In the proposed framework, we incorporate uncertainty information derived from latent motion dynamics into the kernel structure. Specifically, entropy-based measures computed from thr spatio-temporal features( f f ) and the derivative representations ( v v , a a , and j j ) are utilized to define adaptive length-scale parameters, enabling the kernel to adjust its similarity structure according to motion stability and irregularity.
blocks.zh: 在拟议的框架中,我们把从潜在运动动态中得出的不确定性信息纳入内核结构。 具体地说,利用从spatio-时态特征(f f)和衍生表达(v v, a, 和 j )中计算出的肽基量度来定义适应性长度尺度参数,使内核能够根据运动稳定性和不规则性调整其相似性结构.

blocks.en: Since entropy-derived uncertainty measures exhibit relatively small magnitudes, a constant normalization factor is applied within the length-scale formulation to ensure numerical stability of the exponential function. This normalization preserves the relative structure of uncertainty values while preventing kernel saturation or vanishing similarity effects. The scaling factor is fixed across all experiments and does not introduce additional learnable hyperparameters.

blocks.en: 4 Performance Analysis
blocks.zh: 4 业绩分析

blocks.en: In this section, the proposed RF-DUAGP-Tree framework is evaluated on the JIGSAWS and Capsulorhexis datasets for automated surgical skill assessment (ASSA). The evaluation includes four surgical tasks: Capsulorhexis from cataract surgery and the suturing, knot-tying, and needle-passing tasks from JIGSAWS. Skill levels are represented by two classes (novice and expert) for Capsulorhexis and three classes (novice, intermediate, and expert) for JIGSAWS. For each task, a separate model is trained while maintaining the same network architecture. To reduce computational complexity, all videos are spatially resized during both training and testing.
blocks.zh: 在这一节中,对拟议的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架在JIGSAWS和Capsulorhexis数据集上进行评价,以便进行自动化外科技术评估。 评价包括四项外科任务: 白内障手术的胸罩 以及JIGSAWS的缝纫、结节和针刺任务 技能级别由两个班级(创新和专家)组成,两个班级(创新、中级和专家)由JIGSAWS组成。 对于每项任务,在保持同一个网络架构的同时,培训了一个单独的模型. 为了减少计算的复杂性,所有视频在培训和测试期间都进行了空间调整。

blocks.en: The experimental study is designed to investigate several components of the proposed framework. First, the effectiveness of the newly designed clip-level semantic features is examined using different feature-stream configurations. Second, various semantic compositional kernels and uncertainty-aware kernels are evaluated through ablation experiments. Third, the impact of utilizing flow-layer features, pre-classification-layer features, and their combinations is investigated. Finally, RF-DUAGP-Tree is compared with state-of-the-art methods under the same evaluation protocols.
blocks.zh: 试验性研究旨在调查拟议框架的若干组成部分。 首先,使用不同的特征流配置来检查新设计的剪辑级语义特征的有效性. 其次,各种语义组成内核和不确定性意识内核通过衰减实验进行评估. 第三,研究利用流层特征,预分类层特征及其组合的影响. 最后,将RF-DUAGP-Tree与同一评价协议中最先进的方法进行比较。

blocks.en: 4.1 Flow Architecture Representation
blocks.zh: 4.1 流动结构代表性

blocks.en: Due to the limited size of the JIGSAWS and Capsulorhexis datasets, end-to-end training of the Representation Flow (RF) network resulted in rapid overfitting. Therefore, the pretrained RF model was only fine-tuned for two to three epochs to adapt the extracted representations to each surgical task while preserving generalization capability.
blocks.zh: 由于JIGSAWS和Capsulorhexis数据集规模有限,代表流(RF)网络的端到端培训导致快速过度调整. 因此,经过预先训练的RF模型仅对两到三个纪元进行了微调,以在保持通俗化能力的同时,使提取的表示适应每个外科任务.

blocks.en: The RF hyperparameters follow the original configuration proposed in [ 26 ] . An adaptive learning rate initialized at 10 − 5 10^{-5} was employed. The batch size, momentum, weight decay, and maximum gradient norm were set to 1, 0.9, 10 − 6 10^{-6} , and 100, respectively. During fine-tuning, only the flow-layer parameters λ \lambda , θ \theta , and τ \tau were updated, whereas w x w_{x} and w y w_{y} remained fixed. This configuration follows the findings reported in [ 26 ] , where fixing w x w_{x} and w y w_{y} yielded superior performance.
blocks.zh: RF超参数按照[26]提出的原始配置. 采用了10 - 5 10 - 5的适应性学习率。 批量大小、动力、重量衰减和最大梯度规范分别定为1、0.9、10 - 6、10 - 6 和100。 在微调时,只有流层参数 \\ lambda,\\theta,\\ tau 被更新,而 w x w_{x} 和 w y w_{y} 仍然固定 。 这种配置遵循了[26]中报告的调查结果,其中wx w_{x}和wy y_{y}的修饰产生了优异的性能.

blocks.en: For all experiments, each batch consisted of a single video clip containing 300 frames. Furthermore, the temporal order of clips was preserved during feature extraction and storage.
blocks.zh: 对所有实验来说,每批实验都由一个包含300帧的视频片段组成. 此外,剪辑的时间顺序在地物提取和储存期间得到保留。

blocks.en: 4.2 Employing DUAGP-Tree
blocks.zh: 4.2 使用DUAGP-Tree

blocks.en: As discussed earlier, the input to the DUAGP-Tree classifier can be derived from either the flow-layer outputs or the pre-classification-layer outputs of the RF network, as illustrated in Figure 2 . Depending on the experiment, these feature streams are employed individually or combined as separate semantic components of the final representation.
blocks.zh: 如前所述,对DUAGP-Tree分类器的输入可以来自流层输出或RF网络预分类层输出,如图2所示. 视试验情况而定,这些特征流被单独使用或合并为最终代表的单独语义成分.

blocks.en: DUAGP-Tree is trained using the variational evidence lower bound (ELBO) objective associated with sparse Gaussian Process classification. During evaluation, classification performance is assessed using the cross-entropy loss and the corresponding prediction metrics.
blocks.zh: DUAGP-Tree使用与稀疏的高斯工艺分类相关的变异证据下限(ELBO)目标进行训练. 在评价期间,使用交叉内损和相应的预测指标评估分类业绩。

blocks.en: 4.3 Data preparation
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 数据编制

blocks.en: The original video resolution for all three JIGSAWS tasks is 640 × 480 640\times 480 , whereas the Capsulorhexis videos have a resolution of 720 × 480 720\times 480 . For all experiments, the video frames were resized to 112 × 112 112\times 112 prior to feature extraction.
blocks.zh: JIGSAWS全部三项任务的原始视频分辨率为640×480 640\times 480,而Capsulorhexis视频的分辨率为720×480 720\times 480. 在所有实验中,视频帧在特征提取前被调整为112×112112\times 112.

blocks.en: As summarized in Table 1 , the videos exhibit substantial variations in duration across tasks and datasets. To obtain a consistent input representation and facilitate feature extraction, each video was partitioned into consecutive clips of 300 frames. The partitioning of videos into training and test folds is performed on video and case identifiers before clip extraction; see 4.3.1 .This clip-based representation enables the proposed framework to process videos of varying lengths while preserving their temporal structure.
blocks.zh: 如表1所示,各任务和数据集的视频持续时间差别很大。 为了获得一致的输入表示并方便特征提取,每段视频被分为连续的300帧片段. 在剪辑提取之前,用视频和案例识别符将视频分为培训和测试折叠;见4.3.1。 这种以剪辑为基础的表述方式使拟议框架能够处理不同长度的视频,同时保留其时间结构。

blocks.en: 4.3.1 Evaluation protocols and data partitioning
blocks.zh: 4.3.1 评价协议和数据分区

blocks.en: Unit of classification. The sample unit is a complete video. Clips are an internal device for processing videos of unequal length: the clip-level feature maps of a video are aggregated into a single video-level representation carrying a single label before the classifier is constructed 3.1 , so no clip is ever an independent sample. A video is therefore atomic with respect to every train/test partition, and clips of one video cannot be distributed across folds. Order of operations. For every fold the procedure is: (1) partition the video/case identifiers into training and test sets; (2) extract 300-frame clips from the videos of each set separately; (3) fine-tune the Representation Flow front end on the training videos only; (4) extract feature maps and compute the per-video representations; (5) estimate all across-sample statistics on the training set and apply them unchanged to the test set; (6) fit DUAGP-Tree on the training set and score the test set once. JIGSAWS protocols. We use the cross-validation definitions distributed with JIGSAWS. A user is one of the eight surgeons, identified by the letter of the trial identifier (e.g. Suturing_B001 belongs to user B ); each user has one self-reported experience level, constant across all of that user’s trials. Super-trial i i is the set containing the i i -th trial of every user. Leave-one-super-trial-out (LOSO) therefore comprises five folds, fold i i testing on super-trial i i ; every user appears in the training set of every LOSO fold. Leave-one-user-out (LOUO) comprises eight folds, fold u u testing on all trials of user u u , who appears in no training fold. Both protocols use the identical mechanism and differ only in the grouping key. Because both capture views of a trial are used as separate videos — which is why the video counts in Table 1 are twice the corresponding trial counts — the two views share a trial identifier and are always assigned to the same fold under both protocols. The video identifiers of every fold are listed in Supplementary Table S1. Capsulorhexis protocol. The partition is made on case/video identifiers, with 30 videos for training and 28 disjoint videos for testing; no case contributes to both sides. (Add the grouping variable if the released metadata permits, e.g. and no operating surgeon appears on both sides) Estimation is confined to the training fold. Two kinds of statistic must be distinguished. The per-video summary statistics of 4.4 (mean, standard deviation, energy, entropy and clip count) are computed within a single video , over that video’s own clips; they are properties of an individual sample and involve no information from any other sample, in either fold. All statistics estimated across samples are computed on the training fold alone and applied unchanged to the held-out fold: feature standardisation; the k k -means++ assignment of labels to tree nodes; the initialisation and optimisation of the inducing locations 𝐗 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{X}} ; and all kernel hyperparameters, comprising the ARD length-scales, the output scale, the uncertainty length-scales of Eqs. (15)–(17) and the composition weights, all obtained by maximising the training-fold evidence lower bound. The weights λ v \lambda_{v} , λ a \lambda_{a} and λ j \lambda_{j} are fixed to unity a priori . Each test fold is used exactly once, for scoring; no early stopping, threshold selection or model selection is performed on held-out data.

blocks.en: As described in the previous section, the proposed framework operates on clip-level feature representations extracted from the Representation Flow (RF) network. For each video, the outputs of the pre-classification layer and the flow layer form feature maps of size n × 2048 × 73 n\times 2048\times 73 and n × 512 × 73 n\times 512\times 73 , 2.3 respectively, where n n denotes the number of clips. In both representations, the dimension of size 73 corresponds to the temporal axis, whereas the remaining dimensions represent the learned feature distributions.

blocks.en: • Variant-S evaluated on Capsulorhexis. Section 4.7 already reports that “utilizing the original feature maps without abstraction resulted in lower classification performance” on Capsulorhexis. That is the structured variant evaluated on the compact dataset, and it was worse. We now report it as a numbered row with its metrics (accuracy, F1, AUC of the structured variant on Capsulorhexis) instead of as a sentence. • The stream decomposition evaluated on Capsulorhexis. The justification for omitting Eq. (12) on Capsulorhexis is likewise already measured, in Table 6 . Strategy 1 uses both streams; Strategies 3 and 4 use one stream each. blocks.en:
The principle is stated as a rule rather than a post-hoc rationalisation: retain structure when the training set is comparatively large and acquisition is standardised, so that the retained dimensions carry signal rather than nuisance; summarise when D raw / N train D_{\mathrm{raw}}/N_{\mathrm{train}} is large and appearance variability is high, in which case summary statistics act as a marginalisation over nuisance factors and a variance-reduction step. The same rule is what we recommend for new datasets in the new 5.5 .
The Capsulorhexis dataset benefits from a compact feature abstraction that summarizes the most informative motion characteristics, whereas the JIGSAWS dataset preserves a larger portion of the original feature structure to retain task-relevant temporal information. The details of these feature representations are described in the following subsections.

blocks.en: Capsulorhexis

blocks.en: As discussed previously, the proposed representation consists of four feature categories, namely f f , v v , a a , and j j .

To obtain a compact representation, the temporal dimension is first aggregated, followed by aggregation over the embedding dimension. The same procedure is applied to compute the corresponding standard deviation. In addition, the number of clips is included as a separate feature. Consequently, the f f category is represented by five feature points per video.

blocks.en: 4.5 Training and Test Process
blocks.zh: 4.5 培训和试验进程

blocks.en: To evaluate the proposed framework, four feature configurations were examined for both the JIGSAWS and Capsulorhexis datasets. These configurations include: (1) utilizing both flow-layer and pre-classification-layer features, (2) employing the three f f feature points extracted from the pre-classification-layer feature maps together with the flow-layer feature points from the v v , a a , and j j categories, (3) using only flow-layer features, and (4) using only pre-classification-layer features.
blocks.zh: 为了评价拟议框架,对JIGSAWS和Capsulorhexis数据集的四个特征配置进行了审查。 这些配置包括:(1)同时使用流层和预分类层特征,(2)使用从预分类层特征图中提取的3 f f 特征点以及从v v,a,j 类中提取的流层特征点,(3)只使用流层特征,(4)只使用预分类层特征.

blocks.en: For JIGSAWS, when both feature streams are utilized, the flow-layer and pre-classification-layer representations are modeled separately due to their different embedding structures and are subsequently combined through the semantic compositional kernel formulation introduced in Section 10 . In contrast, the Capsulorhexis dataset does not require this explicit separation, and all feature configurations are directly evaluated within the DUAGP-Tree framework.
blocks.zh: 对于JIGSAWS,在使用两个特征流时,流层和预分类层的表示因嵌入结构不同而分别建模,然后通过第10节中引入的语义组成内核配体进行组合. 相比之下,Capsulorhexis数据集并不要求这种明确分离,所有特性配置都在DUAGP-Tree框架内直接评价.

blocks.en: For all feature configurations, multiple kernel combinations were investigated, including conventional kernels, semantic compositional kernels, and the proposed uncertainty-aware kernels. This experimental design enables a comprehensive evaluation of the contributions of both the proposed feature representations and kernel formulations.
blocks.zh: 对所有特性配置,对多个内核组合进行了调查,包括常规内核,语义组成内核,以及拟议的不确定性-意识内核. 这一实验设计能够对拟议特征说明和内核配方的贡献进行全面评价。

blocks.en: 4.6 Results
blocks.zh: 4.6 结果

blocks.en: In this section, the performance of the proposed RF-DUAGP-Tree framework is evaluated under different feature-utilization strategies and semantic compositional uncertainty kernel (SCUK) formulations. A total of 12 experimental settings are considered, as summarized in Table 5 , where the labels M1–M12 are introduced for concise reference throughout the discussion.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,对拟议的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架的执行情况根据不同的特性利用战略和语义构成不确定性内核(SCUK)配方进行评估。 如表5所概述,共考虑12个实验设置,在讨论期间采用M1-M12的标签作简要参考。

blocks.en: Models M1–M3 correspond to the first feature-utilization strategy (S1) combined with the three proposed SCUK variants. Similarly, M4–M6, M7–M9, and M10–M12 evaluate the second (S2), third (S3), and fourth (S4) feature-utilization strategies, respectively, each under the same three SCUK formulations.
blocks.zh: M1-M3型号与第一个特性利用战略(S1)和三个拟议的SCUK变体相对应。 同样,M4-M6、M7-M9和M10-M12分别评价了第二种(S2)、第三种(S3)和第四种(S4)特性利用战略,每种战略都是在相同的三种SCUK配方下进行的。

blocks.en: For all experiments, separate kernel components are constructed for the f f , v v , a a , and j j feature categories to preserve their distinct semantic characteristics. Furthermore, the uncertainty-aware kernels and entropy-aware kernel formulations described in Section 3.2 are employed within the SCUK framework to model uncertainty information associated with the different feature categories.

blocks.en: (i) Why LOSO is structurally easier than LOUO on JIGSAWS. Three facts combine: 1. In JIGSAWS the skill label is assigned per surgeon , on the basis of reported hours of robotic experience, and is therefore constant across all trials of a given surgeon within a task. 2. Leave-one-super-trial-out holds out the i i -th trial of every surgeon and trains on the remaining trials of those same surgeons . Every surgeon in the test fold has therefore been seen, under the same label, during training. 3. It follows that the label of a held-out trial is a deterministic function of its surgeon’s identity, and surgeon identity is highly recoverable from a surgical video — from instrument-handling idiosyncrasies, characteristic tempo, and the trial-specific scene configuration. LOSO on JIGSAWS can therefore be solved by surgeon re-identification followed by a table lookup, without any transferable notion of skill. LOUO removes precisely this shortcut: the test surgeon appears in no training fold, so the model must generalise across operators. This is why our generalisation claims now rest exclusively on LOUO.
blocks.zh: 在JIGSAWS方面,LOSO在结构上为何比LOOO容易? 三个事实结合在一起: 1. 在JIGSAWS中,技能标签是根据所报告的机器人经验为每个外科医生指定的,因此在任务范围内对某个外科医生的所有试验中都是不变的。 2. 单独审判和超审判,对每个外科医生进行第一期审判,并对其余的同一批外科医生进行审判。 因此,在培训期间,在同一个标签下,可以看到测试折叠的每个外科医生。 3. 因此,被搁置审判的标签是对其外科医生身份的一种确定性功能,外科医生的身份可以从外科录像——从仪器处理的特异性、特征节奏和审判特定场景配置——中非常容易找到。 因此,关于JIGSAWS的LOSO可以通过外科医生重新鉴定,然后进行桌子检查来解决,没有任何可转移的技能概念。 LOUO完全删除了这个快捷键:测试外科医生没有出现在训练折叠中,所以模型必须泛指操作员. 这就是为什么我们的概括要求 现在只靠LOUO。

blocks.en: In JIGSAWS the skill label is assigned per surgeon , on the basis of reported hours of robotic experience, and is therefore constant across all trials of a given surgeon within a task.
blocks.zh: 在JIGSAWS中,技能标签是根据据报的机器人时间经验给每个外科医生分配的,因此在任务范围内对某个外科医生的所有试验中都是不变的。

blocks.en: Leave-one-super-trial-out holds out the i i -th trial of every surgeon and trains on the remaining trials of those same surgeons . Every surgeon in the test fold has therefore been seen, under the same label, during training.
blocks.zh: 离开一个超级审判 将每个外科医生的i -第2次审判 并训练其余的 试验这些外科医生。 因此,在培训期间,在同一个标签下,可以看到测试折叠的每个外科医生。

blocks.en: It follows that the label of a held-out trial is a deterministic function of its surgeon’s identity, and surgeon identity is highly recoverable from a surgical video — from instrument-handling idiosyncrasies, characteristic tempo, and the trial-specific scene configuration.
blocks.zh: 由此可见,搁置审判的标签是其外科医生身份的决定性功能,外科医生的身份可以从外科录像——从仪器处理的特异性,特征节奏,以及审判特定场景配置——中高度回溯.

blocks.en: (ii) The result is not unprecedented. Table 10 of the submitted manuscript already shows that the 3D-convolutional baseline reports 100% LOSO accuracy on Suturing and Needle-Passing and 95.8% on Knot-Tying. Saturation under this protocol is thus a documented property of the benchmark, which is a further reason to treat a perfect LOSO score as a sanity check rather than as evidence of superiority. We now state this explicitly next to Table 14 , and we no longer present the LOSO row as a headline result.
blocks.zh: (二) 结果并非前所未有的。 提交的手稿表10已经表明,3D演化基线报告关于缝纫和针刺的准确度为100%,关于Knot-Tying的准确度为95.8%。 因此,该议定书下的饱和度是基准的文献属性,这是将完美的LOSO分数视为理智检查而不是优越性证据的又一个原因. 我们现在在表14旁边明确声明这一点,我们不再将LOSO一行作为标题结果。

blocks.en: (iii) Why all feature strategies give identical numbers. Three reasons, which we now give in the text: • The metric has coarse resolution, and zero errors is an absorbing state. With ⟨ n fold ⟩ \langle n_{\mathrm{fold}}\rangle test videos per LOSO fold, accuracy moves in steps of 1 / n fold 1/n_{\mathrm{fold}} within a fold. Once every configuration classifies every test video correctly, the metric cannot distinguish them further; identical values indicate that all configurations lie above the separation threshold, not that they are the same model. • The configurations share everything except the kernel composition. All twelve use the same RF features, the same tree and the same inference procedure; they differ only in which sub-kernels are summed. When the video-level representations of the two or three classes are already well separated in the training fold, every composition yields the same zero-error decision rule. • The configurations are demonstrably not equivalent when the problem is not saturated. This is the strongest evidence that the identical LOSO values reflect a saturated metric rather than an insensitive model: on Capsulorhexis, where several configurations tie at 0.892 accuracy, the AUC still separates them across the range 0.862–0.974; and under LOUO the same twelve configurations spread over 22 accuracy points (75.0–97.3). We now make this cross-reference explicitly, because it converts an apparent anomaly into an interpretable observation.

blocks.en: 4.7 Ablation Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.7 分析

blocks.en: The ablation analysis was conducted to investigate the contributions of different feature-utilization strategies and uncertainty-aware kernel formulations within the proposed RF-DUAGP-Tree framework. The analysis is based on the experimental results reported in Tables 6 – 11 .
blocks.zh: 进行了扩展分析,以调查在拟议的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架内不同特性利用战略和具有不确定性的内核配方的贡献。 分析的依据是表6-11报告的实验结果。

blocks.en: The Capsulorhexis results further highlight the importance of the proposed feature summarization strategy. Empirically, utilizing the original feature maps without abstraction resulted in lower classification performance, whereas the summarized feature representation consistently improved the effectiveness of the DUAGP-Tree classifier.
blocks.zh: Capsulorhexis的成果进一步突出了拟议特征总结战略的重要性。 从经验上讲,不抽象地使用原始的特征图导致分类性能下降,而汇总的特征表现则不断提高DUAGP-Tree分类器的有效性.

blocks.en: The joint use of the two RF feature streams is by far the dominant factor (up to + 22.3 +22.3 accuracy points under LOUO); the inclusion of the higher-order dynamic (jerk) term is a consistent but much smaller second contributor ( 0 0 to + 3.5 +3.5 points, and + 0.056 +0.056 AUC on Capsulorhexis); and the choice among the three SCUK formulations is the smallest factor, improving on the reduced kernel of Eq. 8 but not on the full composition of Eq. 7 . This finding suggests that compact statistical representations are more suitable for limited-data surgical skill assessment scenarios.

blocks.en: The results consistently demonstrate the importance of the feature-utilization strategy. Across all JIGSAWS tasks under the more challenging LOUO protocol, Strategy 1 achieves the highest classification performance. This strategy jointly utilizes the flow-layer and pre-classification-layer feature streams, indicating that the two representations provide complementary information for surgical skill assessment. In contrast, strategies relying on partial feature combinations or individual feature streams generally result in lower classification performance.
blocks.zh: 结果始终表明利用特征战略的重要性。 在更具挑战性的LOUO协议下的所有JIGSAWS任务中,战略1实现了最高的分类性能. 这一战略共同利用了流程层和预分类层的特征流,表明这两种表述为手术技能评估提供了补充信息。 相比之下,依赖部分特征组合或单个特征流的战略一般导致分类性能较低.

blocks.en: The analysis further highlights the contribution of the proposed uncertainty-aware kernel design. While all SCUK variants achieve competitive performance, the highest-performing configurations across the JIGSAWS LOUO experiments consistently incorporate the EA subkernel. This observation suggests that the entropy-of-entropy uncertainty formulation captures informative variations in latent motion dynamics that are beneficial for skill discrimination. Overall, the results confirm that both the proposed feature integration strategy and uncertainty-aware kernel formulation contribute to the effectiveness of the RF-DUAGP-Tree framework.
blocks.zh: 分析进一步突出了拟议中的不确定性意识内核设计的贡献。 虽然所有的SCUK变体都实现了竞争性能,但JIGSAWS LOUO实验中表现最高的配置始终包含EA子内核. 这一观点表明,内脏不确定性的表述能够捕捉潜在运动动态的丰富变化,有利于技能歧视。 总的来说,结果证实,拟议的特征整合战略和对不确定性的认识内核的制定都有助于提高RF-DUAGP-Tree框架的有效性。

blocks.en: To quantify how much of the reported performance depends on the particular kernel choice, the accuracy dispersion across the three SCUK variants within Strategy 1 under LOUO is 95.3 ± 1.6 95.3\pm 1.6 (Suturing), 97.3 ± 0.0 97.3\pm 0.0 (Knot-Tying), and 96.5 ± 0.7 96.5\pm 0.7 (Needle-Passing). Because each LOUO fold contains only 3-5(in one view):6-10(in two viwes) test videos, a single misclassified video moves the reported accuracy by ≈ 1 \approx 1 – 3 3 points, and differences of this order between configurations should not be over-interpreted.

blocks.en: 4.8 Comparison with State-of-the-Art Methods
blocks.zh: 4.8 与最新方法的比较

blocks.en: The comparison with state-of-the-art methods demonstrates the effectiveness of the proposed RF-DUAGP-Tree framework across both JIGSAWS and Capsulorhexis datasets. On JIGSAWS under the LOSO protocol, the proposed method achieves perfect classification performance across all surgical tasks. LOSO is not a cross-subject protocol: every surgeon appears in the training fold and the skill label is a per-surgeon constant, so this result should be read as a consistency check rather than as evidence of cross-subject generalisation (see 4.6 ). Given the limited scale and structured nature of the dataset, these results reflect the high separability of surgical motion patterns when modeled with strong motion-aware inductive biases.
blocks.zh: 与最新方法的比较表明,拟议中的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架在JIGSAWS和Capsulorhexis数据集之间是有效的。 关于LOSO协议下的JIGSAWS,拟议方法在所有手术任务中都实现了完美的分类性能. LOSO不是跨主题协议:每个外科医生都出现在训练折叠中,技能标签是每个外科医生的常数,因此这一结果应该被解读为一致性检查,而不是交叉主题概括的证据(见4.6). 鉴于数据集的规模和结构有限,这些结果反映了手术运动模式在具有强烈运动意识的递减偏差的模型中高度分离.

blocks.en: Under the more challenging LOUO protocol, the proposed approach achieves a mean accuracy of 96.86%, consistently outperforming recent methods including VBA-Net, Yanik et al [ 30 ] ., particularly in unseen subject scenarios. This demonstrates the effectiveness of integrating motion dynamics modeling with uncertainty-aware Gaussian Process tree structures, which improves generalization under inter-subject variability.
blocks.zh: 根据更具挑战性的LOUO协议,拟议方法的平均准确度达到96.86%,一贯优于最近的方法,包括VBA-Net、Yanik等人[30].,特别是在未见的主题情景中。 这表明了将运动动力学模型与具有不确定性意识的高斯过程树结构相结合的有效性,这改善了在主体间可变性下的概括性.

blocks.en: On the Capsulorhexis dataset, which is characterized by limited training data availability, the proposed RF-DUAGP-Tree framework achieves superior performance across all evaluation metrics compared to existing methods. with roughly one fifth of the training videos used by the benchmark’s deep baselines, the proposed framework attains higher accuracy and F1 on the same test protocol. This is a two-point comparison rather than a learning curve, and that a systematic learning-curve analysis over progressively larger training subsets remains necessary to establish superior data efficiency in general. That analysis is named as future work in 5.4
blocks.zh: 在以有限的培训数据提供为特点的Capsulorhexis数据集上,拟议的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架比现有方法在所有评价指标上都取得了优异的业绩。 在基准深度基线中使用的大约五分之一的培训录像中,拟议框架的精确度更高,F1的测试规程也更高。 这是两点比较,而不是学习曲线,对于逐步扩大的培训子集,系统化的学习曲线分析仍然是建立一般的优越数据效率所必需的. 5.4将这一分析列为今后的工作。

blocks.en: Overall, the proposed framework consistently delivers competitive and robust performance across benchmarks. However, further evaluation on more diverse clinical datasets is necessary to fully assess its scalability and generalization capability in unconstrained surgical environments.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,拟议框架始终能提供跨基准的竞争性强效业绩。 然而,需要进一步评价更加多样化的临床数据集,以便全面评估其在不受限制的外科环境中的可扩展性和通化能力。

blocks.zh: 5 讨论情况

blocks.en: 5.1 Summary of contributions and main findings
blocks.zh: 5.1 贡献和主要调查结果摘要

blocks.en: The main contributions of this study are fourfold. First, we propose RF-DUAGP-Tree, a novel framework that integrates Representation Flow-based spatio-temporal feature extraction with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware Gaussian Process Tree classifier for surgical skill assessment. Second, we introduce a set of clip-level semantic motion descriptors, including motion trend, acceleration, and jerk, which capture higher-order latent surgical dynamics and serve both as discriminative features and uncertainty indicators. Third, we develop Semantic Compositional Uncertainty Kernels (SCUK), a structured kernel design, whose semantic structure is fixed and whose only dataset-dependent choices are the representation compactness and the stream composition, that explicitly models the heterogeneous semantics of latent motion representations and adapts to the characteristics of different surgical datasets. Finally, we propose uncertainty-aware ARD-RBF kernels that incorporate entropy-driven measures of latent motion variability, improving robustness to temporal fluctuations, abnormal transitions, and limited-data training scenarios while maintaining computational efficiency 4.9 .
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要贡献有四倍。 首先,我们提出RF-DUAGP-Tree,这是一种新颖的框架,将基于表现流的Spatio-时态特征提取与动态和不确定性的Gaussian过程树分类器结合起来,用于手术技能评估。 其次,我们引入了一套剪切层次的语义运动描述符,包括运动趋势,加速,和混蛋,它们能捕捉更高顺序的潜在外科动力学,并同时作为歧视特征和不确定性指标. 第三,我们开发了语义组成不确定的内核(SCUK),这是一种结构化的内核设计,其语义结构是固定的,其唯一依赖数据集的选择是表达紧凑性和流性组成,它明确模拟了潜伏运动表现的不同语义,并适应了不同外科数据集的特点. 最后,我们提出不确定性意识ARD-RBF内核,其中包含潜在运动变异性的肽驱动措施,改善对时间波动、异常过渡和有限数据培训的稳健性,同时保持计算效率4.9。

blocks.en: 5.2 Implications for surgical training and quality assurance
blocks.zh: 5.2 对外科培训和质量保证的影响

blocks.en: A practical implication of this work is the feasibility of deploying video-only assessment in settings where kinematic or tool-tracking signals are unavailable or costly to obtain. A lightweight model that operates on limited data can reduce the burden of full-length video processing and can support more frequent formative assessment. In training curricula, such a system can be integrated as (i) a periodic proficiency check, (ii) an objective progress indicator across sessions, and (iii) a triage tool to direct expert feedback toward trainees most in need of supervision. From a quality-assurance perspective, the computational efficiency 4.9 of the DUAGP-Tree-based classifier supports near-real-time use, which may enable scalable auditing in simulation centers. These are prospective applications. No user study, questionnaire or structured evaluation with surgeons was conducted as part of this work, and the clinical utility of the framework — including whether its outputs are interpretable and actionable for trainees — remains to be established. We regard a prospective evaluation with surgical educators as a necessary next step before any deployment claim can be made.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的一个实际影响是,在没有动态信号或工具跟踪信号或获取费用昂贵的情况下,采用仅进行视频评估的可行性。 在有限数据上运行的轻量级模型可以减轻全长视频处理的负担,并能支持更频繁的成型评估. 在培训课程中,这种系统可以纳入:(一) 定期的熟练程度检查,(二) 跨课程的客观进度指标,(三) 将专家反馈指导给最需要监督的受训人员的一个分门别类工具。 从质量保证的角度来看,基于DUAGP-Tree的分类器的计算效率4.9支持近实时使用,这可以使模拟中心能够进行可扩展的审计. 这些是潜在的应用。 作为这项工作的一部分,没有与外科医生进行用户研究、问卷调查或结构化评价,框架的临床用途——包括其产出是否可解释和是否可以对受训人员采取行动——仍有待确定。 我们认为,对外科教育者进行预期评估是提出部署要求的下一步的必要步骤。

blocks.en: 5.3 Positioning with respect to prior video-based SSA literature
blocks.zh: 5.3 对以往基于视频的SSA文献的立场

blocks.en: Prior work on JIGSAWS has demonstrated that spatiotemporal video models (e.g., 3D CNNs) can achieve strong performance but often require substantial compute and/or a lot of videos for processing. In contrast, our approach targets the regime of limited data and emphasizes computational efficiency Table 17 by combining a pretrained motion-aware backbone (Representation Flow) with a sparse none-parametric Bayesian strategy. Importantly, the GP-based classifier provides a probabilistic decision function and can be trained with comparatively few trainable parameters, which is beneficial on datasets with limited trials per class such as Capsulorhexis (Table 6 ).
blocks.zh: 此前JIGSAWS的研究表明,spatiental视频模型(如3D CNN)可以实现强性能,但往往需要大量计算和/或大量视频处理. 与此相反,我们的方法针对的是有限的数据制度,强调计算效率。 表17将事先训练好的运动意识主干(代表流动)与稀少的无参数贝叶斯战略相结合。 重要的是,基于GP的分类器提供了一种概率化的决定功能,并且可以用相对较少的可训练参数进行训练,这有利于每类试验有限的数据集,如Capsulorhexis(表6).

blocks.en: 5.4 Limitations and future work
blocks.zh: 5.4 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: This study is evaluated on two benchmark datasets, JIGSAWS with 3 tasks and three skill levels and Capsulorhexis with one task and two skill levels. While the results are promising, generalization to other procedures, camera viewpoints, and clinical environments should be validated. Moreover, although DUAGP-Tree is dynamics-aware and uncertainty-aware for feature maps, additional analysis is needed to quantify the impact of the uncertainty and dynamics estimation components under controlled ablations. Future work will include: (i) direct comparisons to more recent transformer-based video backbones under matched settings, (ii) extension to continuous skill scoring rather than discrete labels.
blocks.zh: 这项研究通过两个基准数据集进行评估,JIGSAWS有3项任务和3个技能级别,Capsulorhexis有1项任务和2个技能级别. 虽然结果很有希望,但对其他程序、照相机观点和临床环境的概括应加以验证。 此外,虽然DUAGP-Tree对地物图具有动态意识和不确定性意识,但还需要进行更多分析,以量化受控地块下的不确定性和动态估计成分的影响。 今后的工作将包括:(一) 在匹配的设置下,直接比较较近期基于变压器的视频主干线,(二) 推广到连续技能评分而不是离散标签。

blocks.en: The following limitations should be taken into account when interpreting the results. (i) Evaluation scope. The framework is evaluated on two datasets: JIGSAWS, comprising three bench-top tasks with three skill levels, and the Capsulorhexis subset of Cataract-LMM, comprising one clinical task with two skill levels. JIGSAWS is a simulator dataset recorded at a single centre with a fixed camera; generalisation to other procedures, camera viewpoints, and clinical environments therefore remains to be validated. No cross-dataset transfer experiment was performed: a model trained on one dataset was not evaluated on the other. (ii) Model selection. We report the complete grid of twelve feature and kernel configurations for every task and protocol, so that no configuration is hidden; however, no nested cross-validation or inner validation loop was used to select among them. The values reported in Tables 10–12 are consequently the best of a fully reported grid and should be read as an upper estimate of achievable performance rather than as an unbiased estimate of the generalisation error of a pre-specified configuration. Establishing the latter would require nested cross-validation, which we identify as necessary future work. (iii) Stochastic variability. All reported results were obtained with a single random seed, which is released with the code. Feature extracted across 2 or 3 epochs, fine-tuning (adapting) the pretrained weights. Repetition over multiple seeds was not performed, and the dispersion we report is over cross-validation folds and over configurations rather than over seeds. (iv) Computational reporting. We report trainable parameter counts, asymptotic complexity, and measured training and inference times on a single stated hardware configuration (Table 4.9 ). We did not profile floating-point operations, and we did not re-run R3D-18, TimeSformer or a standard GP-Tree baseline on our hardware; the corresponding baseline results are taken from the published benchmark. We therefore make no claim of a wall-clock advantage over those models. Similarly, the data-efficiency evidence is a two-point comparison at two training-set sizes on one dataset, not a learning curve; a systematic learning-curve analysis over progressively larger training subsets is required to establish superior data efficiency in general. (v) Dataset-specific instantiation. The pipeline is applied through two documented instantiations, one structured and one compact ( 3.1 , 5.5 ). The rule that selects between them is derived from two datasets and has not been validated on a third, and the automatic tree construction has been exercised only on two- and three-class problems. (vi) Clinical evaluation. No user study, questionnaire or structured evaluation with surgeons was conducted. Whether the framework’s outputs are interpretable and actionable in surgical education remains an open question and a necessary prerequisite for any deployment claim. Future work will address these points in order of importance: nested cross-validation and multi-seed repetition; a learning-curve analysis and a matched-hardware comparison against transformer-based video backbones; cross-dataset and cross-centre transfer; extension to continuous skill scoring rather than discrete labels; and a prospective evaluation with surgical educators.
blocks.zh: 在解释结果时应考虑到下列限制。 (一) 评价范围。 该框架通过两个数据集进行评估:JIGSAWS(由三个具有三个技能级别的板凳式任务组成)和Cataract-LMM的Capsulorhexis子集(由两个技能级别的临床任务组成)。 JIGSAWS是一个用固定相机录制在单一中心上的模拟数据集;因此,对其他程序、相机观点和临床环境的概括仍有待验证。 没有进行跨数据集传输实验:对一个数据集培训过的模型没有对另一个数据集进行评估。 (二) 模式选择。 我们报告每个任务和协议的十二个特性和内核配置的完整网格,这样就不会隐藏配置;然而,没有使用嵌入式交叉验证或内置验证循环来选择其中. 因此,表10至表12中报告的数值是完整报告网格中最好的,应理解为对可实现性能的上估计,而不是对预先规定的配置的概括性错误的无偏见估计。 建立后一种机制需要嵌入式交叉验证,我们确定这是今后的必要工作。 (三) 结构变化。 所有报告的结果都是用单一的随机种子获得的,该种子随代码发布. 地物提取跨越2或3个纪元,微调(适应)预受训练重量. 我们没有在多个种子上重复,我们报告的分散是交叉验证折叠和配置,而不是种子。 (四)计算报告. 我们报告可训练参数的计数、不对称的复杂性,并衡量单一硬件配置的培训和推断时间(表4.9)。 我们没有配置浮点操作,也没有在硬件上重新运行R3D-18,TimeSformer或标准GP-Tree基线;相应的基线结果取自已公布的基准. 因此,我们不声称比这些模型更有利。 同样,数据效率证据是在一个数据集上对两个培训集大小进行两点比较,而不是一个学习曲线;需要对逐步扩大的培训子集进行系统的学习曲线分析,以便确定总体的优越数据效率。 (五) 数据集特定即时处理。 输油管通过两个有文件记载的即时程序进行,一个是结构化的,一个是紧凑的(3.1、5.5)。 在它们之间选择的规则来自两个数据集,还没有在第三个数据集上验证,自动树构筑只在两个和三个等级的问题上行使. (六)临床评价. 没有与外科医生进行用户研究、问卷调查或结构性评估。 框架的产出在外科教育中是否可解释和可采取行动,仍然是一个未决问题,也是任何部署要求的必要先决条件。 今后的工作将按重要性顺序处理这些要点:嵌入式交叉验证和多种子重复;学习曲线分析和与基于变压器的视频主干网进行配对硬件比较;跨数据集和跨中心转移;延伸至持续技能评分而不是离散标签;与外科教育者进行预期评价。

blocks.en: 5.5 Applying the framework to a new dataset
blocks.zh: 5.5 导弹 将框架应用到新数据集

blocks.en: The framework contains a fixed core and a small dataset-dependent part, and it is useful to state which is which. Fixed by the method, and unchanged between the two datasets studied here, are: the Representation Flow backbone and its two taps; the semantic decomposition of the representation into f f , v v , a a and j j , which is defined by derivative order rather than by the data; the finite-difference dynamics operators; the tree construction; the uncertainty formulation with λ v = λ a = λ j = 1 \lambda_{v}=\lambda_{a}=\lambda_{j}=1 ; and the ARD-RBF sub-kernel family. Dataset-dependent are two binary decisions: whether the representation is retained in structured form or reduced to summary statistics, and whether the two feature streams are modelled by separate kernels composed through Eq. (12). For a new dataset we recommend the following procedure. (1) Define the sample unit as a complete video or case, and choose the grouping key — case, surgeon or centre — according to the generalisation being claimed; partition on that key before extracting clips. (2) Measure N train N_{\mathrm{train}} , the number of classes, the number of videos per class and the range of the clip count; no model is trained at this stage. (3) Extract Representation Flow features once with the pretrained backbone and record the raw dimensionality D raw D_{\mathrm{raw}} . (4) Select the representation: the compact variant when D raw / N train D_{\mathrm{raw}}/N_{\mathrm{train}} is large or acquisition is heterogeneous across centres or devices, and the structured variant when the training set is comparatively large and acquisition is standardised. (5) Select the stream composition by comparing K flow K_{\mathrm{flow}} , K end K_{\mathrm{end}} and a ​ K flow + b ​ K end aK_{\mathrm{flow}}+bK_{\mathrm{end}} on an inner split of the training fold, adopting the composition only when the gain exceeds the inner-fold dispersion; this is the only step that requires model fitting, and each fit is a sparse Gaussian process over a few tens of samples. (6) Leave the remaining components at their defaults. This procedure is derived from two datasets and should be regarded as a guideline rather than a validated selection rule. The framework has not been evaluated on problems with more than three skill classes, on unedited full-length operative video, or in a cross-centre transfer setting, and the automatic tree construction has been exercised only on two- and three-class problems.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we introduced the RF-DUAGP-Tree framework for surgical skill assessment, integrating representation flow-based spatio-temporal feature learning with a dynamics- and uncertainty-aware Gaussian Process Tree classifier. By modeling higher-order motion derivatives and introducing semantic compositional kernels alongside entropy-driven uncertainty-aware ARD-RBF formulations, the proposed method captures fine-grained surgical motion characteristics in a structured probabilistic manner. Extensive evaluations on JIGSAWS and Capsulorhexis demonstrate competitive performance under limited data regimes, while keeping the number of adapted parameters small and requiring no pre-computed optical flow (Table 17 ), highlighting the effectiveness of combining structured semantic modeling with uncertainty-aware kernel design for surgical video analysis.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们引入了用于外科技能评估的RF-DUAGP-Tree框架,将基于表现流的Spatio-时态特征学习与动态和不确定性的Gaussian过程树分类器结合起来。 通过建模高序运动衍生物,并引入语义组分内核与肽-驱动的不确定性-认知的ARD-RBF配体并列,该拟议方法以结构化概率化的方式捕捉到精致的外科运动特征. 对JIGSAWS和Capsulorhexis的广泛评价显示,在有限的数据制度下,具有竞争力,同时使经过调整的参数数量保持小幅,不需要预先计算过的光学流(表17),突出了将结构化语义模型与具有不确定性的内核设计相结合用于外科视频分析的有效性。

blocks.en: The datasets analysed in this study are publicly available. The JIGSAWS (JHU-ISI Gesture and Skill Assessment Working Set) can be accessed from the primary Johns Hopkins Computational Interaction and Robotics Laboratory repository at https://cirl.lcsr.jhu.edu/research/hmm/datasets/jigsaws_release/ or via Figshare at https://figshare.com/s/1fed2f611b9eef3ecc6b . The Capsulorhexis dataset (Skill Assessment subset) is derived from the Cataract-LMM benchmark, which is publicly released on Hugging Face under the repository mjahmadi/Cataract-LMM at https://huggingface.co/datasets/mjahmadi/Cataract-LMM (DOI: https://doi.org/10.57967/hf/8673 ). Both datasets contain fully de-identified recordings collected under institutional oversight. No new human-participant data were collected for this study, and all ethical considerations regarding the use of publicly available de-identified data were observed. The implementation of RF-DUAGP-Tree, together with the exact fold-definition files used for all experiments and the random seed, is available at the repository https://github.com/areferezaee/RF-DUAGP-Tree .
